description: Fork of exp072 (val=1.6975 @ 8K, current best). Same architecture except qk_v2d uses a per-head random subset of qk_random_pairs=496 pair indices (vs 2016 full triu pairs for d_qk=64). Each of H=6 heads has its own random subset, fixed at init. 496 matches the SDPA Q/K dim of exp071 (d_qk=32 baseline) — same SDPA flop, but each head sees a different random ranking projection of d_qk=64 input. Param-neutral.
